lines.text: God performed His wonders in the fields of Zoan and turned the rivers of Egypt to blood.
He sent flies and frogs, gave their crops to the grasshopper, and killed their vines with hailstones.
God led His people out like a flock, and the Jordan engulfed their enemies.
Israel enraged God with their high places and idols, so He abandoned the tabernacle of Bethel.
God chose Judah and David His servant, who shepherded Israel with integrity of heart.
